ov: Two species of antelope from eastern and southern Africa, also called gnus: the blue wildebeest and the black wildebeest. In East Africa the blue wildebeest is the most abundant big-game species.
fx: Some populations migrate each year to follow the rains and fresh grass; the black wildebeest is only nomadic.
